# TopologicalSynchronization

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The phenomenon where the synchronization of dynamical nodes is governed by the underlying ultra-small-world network structure rather than local coupling strengths alone. This provides a design principle for TCC systems to achieve robust global coordination in distributed computing substrates using sparse, high-connectivity topologies.
